title: castle-py3: casTLE for Python 3
description:
castle-py3 is a Python 3 port of casTLE (Cas9 high-Throughput maximum Likelihood Estimator) version 1.0, by David W Morgens, for analyzing pooled CRISPR and shRNA screens. It gives the same results as the original Python 2 scripts; the only change to output files is that genes are listed from highest to lowest casTLE score.

If you use casTLE, please also cite: Morgens DW, Deans RM, Li A, Bassik MC (2016) Systematic comparison of CRISPR/Cas9 and RNAi screens for essential genes. Nat Biotechnol 34:634-636.

For a protocol covering how to generate count files, see: Kim J, Kovacs H, Wisnovsky S (2026) CRISPR screens to identify and characterize ligands for glycan-binding proteins. Methods Enzymol. 219-263. https://doi.org/10.1016/bs.mie.2026.03.005
